hopeful.title: The Clear Air of 2050
hopeful.text: At 3:00 AM, I jog near the mountain campus. The air smells of pine and new biotech filters hum beneath the soil...

cautionary.title: Smog Beneath the Dome
cautionary.text: By 3:00 AM the mountain is hidden. Synthetic shoes creak as I check the air vents—biotech failed again...

balanced.title: Between Filter and Breath
balanced.text: Sometimes the air is crisp, sometimes heavy, but we still meet to test our biotech shoes by the ridge...
